desc: 银罐冰镇水珠质感，空白参数面板与多规格陈列，门口整箱补货收口
leaf: 无糖碳酸饮料银色铝罐整箱装
name: 无糖银罐碳酸饮料整箱款

shots.intent: 在搜索列表里一眼赢下点击：单罐与整箱同框，讲清买到的是一箱而不是一罐。
主图一秒法则：用一只冰罐加三枚空白利益点条，一秒传达核心主张。
放大喝到一半发现家里断档的烦躁，再用门口整箱给出解决姿态。
把产品放进后院聚会的真实时刻，用加冰满杯建立解渴联想。
让买家把自己代入朋友聚会的休息间隙，产品清晰居前景不抢戏。
用金属拉环与冷凝水珠的真实质感证明冰镇与工艺，消除品质疑虑。
承接参数党的浏览习惯，用空白表位预留事实数据，杜绝任何编造。
一次看清规格家族并让买家自己挑，空心标记指到本链接对应的那一款。
用俯视全家福展示同门可选的金属饰面与组合感，抬高客单联想。
收口给行动：产品退到一角，大面积留白交给最终主张与按钮位。

style.backgroundSystem: seamless cool grey studio field #D8D9DB for benefit, spec and range screens, seamless pure white sweep #FFFFFF for the packshot, real warm surfaces only for lifestyle scenes; never a gradient and never a graphic ribbon overlay
style.direction: clean chilled beverage commerce, cool metallic studio grammar
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons in one accent color, hollow circular marker discs, empty rounded rectangular chips, open circular seal frames; no filled badges and no certification artwork
style.lightingSystem: bright even high-key studio light, broad front-left softbox key with a large fill card, tightly controlled speculars on brushed aluminium, soft honest contact shadows; lifestyle scenes keep the same soft key direction but read as low natural sun at 4300K-4800K
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium chilled-beverage commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless cool grey studio field #D8D9DB, clean white #FFFFFF, charcoal ink #2B2B2E and one crimson accent #C42B33; cool neutral tone throughout; bright even high-key studio lighting with a broad front-left softbox key and a large fill card, tightly controlled speculars on brushed aluminium, soft honest contact shadows; seamless paper sweep or matte board backgrounds only on studio screens, real warm surfaces only on lifestyle scenes; modern geometric sans-serif with generous letterspacing and all marketing copy carried as empty placeholder bands rather than rendered words; thin single-weight line icons, hollow circular marker discs and empty seal frames; the slim upright can held at stable scale on a hard contact shadow, condensation only on chilled screens; no brand marks, no script lettering, no ribbon or wave graphic overlay, no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no invented nutrition numbers.
noDrift: no brand marks, wordmarks or script lettering of any kind
no ribbon, swoosh or wave graphic overlay
no color palette changes and no mixed fonts
no random backgrounds and no inconsistent lighting
no invented nutrition numbers, ingredients or serving data
style.presentationRules: the slim can always stands upright on a hard contact shadow except in the macro screen; single-can scale stays constant across the set; condensation beads appear only on chilled screens; group screens keep identical spacing and identical light on every unit; no printed face of the pack is ever readable
style.surfaceSystem: matte seamless paper sweep and matte board for studio screens, weathered timber slats and coarse fibre door mat for scenes, glossy graphite floor only for the group range screen
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif with generous letterspacing for any future headline; in this set all marketing copy is carried as empty placeholder bands and blank chips, never as rendered words
